verdict.rationale: Lorikeet explicitly supports training agents on SOPs (docs-25) and building workflows with 'natural-language and deterministic workflows' plus 'pockets of determinism for regulated steps' (docs-28, docs-32), with workflow-scoped tool access and hard execution caps enforced in code (docs-34), directly matching the deterministic-branching SOP story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of branching logic in practice and more detail on how branching conditions are authored beyond natural-language workflow builder claims.
